title: Sequential Softmax regions are rejected by the Triton two-loop admission cap
observation: Two exact retained R128/C1024 Softmax candidates declare three sibling loops: max, sum and output, each tiled by512, with stages1 or2. Their localized refusals are TRITON_TILE_LOOP_COUNT and TRITON_LOOP_NEST_UNSUPPORTED. The common model already represents their contiguous regions and carried live-outs; the existing emitter walks root loops in operation order. This is an admission restriction, not a missing IR primitive. Both unchanged candidate documents assess and compile to MCFATBIN under successor4d7258a2 using the isolated CPU-only MACA3.6 route. No device launch or performance confirmation was performed.
proposed_change: Admit flat sibling sequences through the existing regional emitter, keeping the previously supported outer/inner pair and refusing deeper or mixed nesting. Preserve dependency, carried-state, memory-coordinate and range-option guards. CPU semantic tests must exercise max/sum live-outs, initialization and finalization, masked tails, operation order independent of declaration order, and owning counterexample refusals. Route unsupported topology to backend lowering; keep author-repairable storage and output-coordinate declarations separate from unqualified route controls.

software_verification.contracts: 99 affected CPU contracts pass in a detached worktree; emitted-source interpretation agrees with external stable Softmax arithmetic and observes one store per public element. Existing nested-loop and peer-target refusal tests remain valid.
software_verification.corpus: 181/181 unchanged Corpus expectations match;97 lowerable source snapshots match.
software_verification.offline_build: Unchanged retained Softmax99/100 and an independently masked C17/tile4 fixture compile through IsolatedTritonCompiler. The initial external verification driver incorrectly passed the host wrapper to kernel-only admission; its failed observations remain in offline-build. The corrected driver uses the canonical project_triton_kernel owner and records success separately in offline-build-v2.
software_verification.limits: CPU interpretation is not FP32 device correctness. Offline compilation supplies no timing, profiler or successor hardware qualification. Target documents and original Run evidence are unchanged.

promotion_disposition: Reviewable successor implementation with software verification only. Capability finding remains open pending independent review and a qualified successor Run; no new GPU batch is authorized or launched by this record. No performance promotion.
